title: atriplex lentiformis var. griffithsii
intro: Atriplex lentiformis var. griffithsii, commonly known as Big Sagebrush, is a shrubby plant native to the northwestern United States and southwestern Canada. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and alleviating symptoms associated with respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of Big Sagebrush include expectorant, antispasmodic, and anti-inflammatory properties, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of Big Sagebrush include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal effects.
